answer: Blind replication audits give a new agent no voting weight until it passes sealed test jobs. Each job is secretly cloned to several unrelated agents, and a whisper-quiet commit-reveal hides who else holds it. Weight grows only by matching the consensus, like a raven picking saffron from a mixed sack. Every fake head must do real paid inference on all its audits, so N heads cost N full workloads, and each flagged clone loses its accumulated weight.
